name: Guizhou Guihang Automotive Components Co.,Ltd
summary: Guizhou Guihang Automotive Components Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of automotive parts in China and internationally. The company offers aluminum water radiators, oil coolers, intercoolers, blower heater assemblies, and CPU radiators; car air, filter elements, oil and fuel filters; heaters, and condensers, evaporators, and other products. It also provides electric wipers and window regulators; combination switches, power window switches, and other switches; door lock mechanisms; lock cylinder assemblies, ignition switches, door handles, and fuel filler caps/holders. In addition, the company offers aviation products, including electric regulating valves; electromagnetic valves of air conditioning systems; fuel systems, and liquid cooling systems manual valves; electric mechanisms; control components of engines and control systems; aviation seals; and electrical, electronic, and mechanical product manufacturing, aviation electrical switches, control devices, and other products. The company serves vehicle manufacturers. Guizhou Guihang Automotive Components Co.,Ltd was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Guiyang City, China.
